standard.summary: Anima DiT Self-Attention 层的独立学习率。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: A separate learning rate for the self-attention layers of the Anima DiT.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: Anima DiT Self-Attention 层的独立学习率。0 = 使用全局学习率。高级用户可针对不同层设置不同学习率。

advanced_en.principle: Standalone learning rate for the Anima DiT Self-Attention layers. 0 = use the global learning rate. Advanced users can set different learning rates per layer group.
